# Evan Goldfine

> Evan Goldfine is a commercial real estate developer and investor in Connecticut and New York, a startup CFO, and the host of A Year of Bach, a blog and podcast about the music of Johann Sebastian Bach.

## About

- [Home](https://evangoldfine.com/): Profile, current ventures, previous roles, and board service
- [Now](https://evangoldfine.com/now/): What Evan is focused on at present

## Real estate and finance

- [Routine Properties](https://routineproperties.com/): Commercial real estate acquisition, development, and leasing; Evan is General Partner
- [Bloom Self-Storage](https://bloomselfstorage.com/): Self-storage facilities; Evan is General Partner
- [Real estate valuation articles](https://medium.com/@evangoldfine): Essays for general readers on how landlords and investors value property
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/evangoldfine000/): Professional history

## Music

- [A Year of Bach](https://yearofbach.substack.com/): Evan's blog and podcast on J. S. Bach, with episode notes and essays
